name: androlua-lua-support
description: Lua / AndroLua (.lua, .aly) language support backed by the luaparser JVM language server (LSP over stdio).

luaparser.jarPath.description: Path to the luaparser JVM jar. Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder, then the extension directory. If a sibling 'lib' directory (same folder as the jar) contains dependency jars, the server is launched via classpath; otherwise via -jar.

luaparser.javaPath.description: Java launcher used to start the language server (a JDK 11+ 'java' binary).

luaparser.jvmArgs.description: Extra JVM arguments passed before the -jar / -cp arguments (e.g. ["-Xmx2g"]).

luaparser.serverSettings.description: Workspace settings forwarded verbatim to the language server via workspace/didChangeConfiguration. Recognized keys: jvm.androidJar, jvm.classpath, jvm.classes, jvm.importPrefixes, androlua.imports, lua.layout.properties.
